name: Slackey
look: a huge idle ape lounging in a dark blue and white swim ring, a white-ribbed chest, big orange hands, a heavy orange brow over bored eyes and a slab of dark blue hair
entry: It spends its days floating in its swim ring and only moves when something gets close enough to punch. One lazy swipe of its arm sends a wave over the whole lake.
how: Evolve Splakey at level 36. It learns Slack Off when it evolves.
